_comment: Copy this file to config.json (or set another path with the VMT23_CONFIG environment variable). This file contains only database and skill_dir; configure LLM and other settings through environment variables or the application.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Priority: VMT23_PG_DSN environment variable > database in this file. Choose one format: (A) fill in the fields below; (B) provide a complete connection string in database.dsn.
_comment_database_dsn: Format (B): remove the database block above and use a complete DSN. Individual fields are ignored when dsn is non-empty.
_comment_skill_dir: Root directory for skills (each subdirectory contains one skill and its SKILL.md). Priority: VMT23_SKILL_DIR environment variable > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave empty or remove this field to use the default. Relative paths are resolved from the current working directory.
